description: A deployer next to EdgeContainerDeployer: build + push to DO Container Registry, apply the Knative Service (min/max scale from EdgeContainerSettings), wait for Ready. The site Worker forwards to the Knative URL with the x-dply-queue-token contract; queue batches and cron triggers post to /_dply/queue and /_dply/schedule the same way they do today. Env/secrets go in as a k8s Secret. Container tab: size list switches to the node-pool sizes.
title: Runtime: `runtime_mode = dedicated` deploy path + Worker forwarding to the cluster
